theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.41%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.09%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-0.38%) and Industrials (-0.35%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.71%, defensives +0.31%, and value/cyclicals +0.14% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +1.06%, Dow +0.68%, Nasdaq +1.57% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +1.10%. The VIX fell 11.41% to 15.69, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.66% to $4,407.40, crude oil was little changed at $101.02, and bitcoin gained 0.68% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
